parameters.name: FuzzBucketName
parameters.description: The name of the bucket that is used for fuzzy match.

parameters.name: HasRisk
parameters.description:
Specifies whether at-risk objects are detected. Valid values:

*   **0**: No at-risk objects are detected.
*   **1**: At-risk objects are detected.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The check status of the bucket. Valid values:

*   **1**: The bucket is not checked.
*   **2**: All objects in the bucket are being checked.
*   **3**: Only new objects in the bucket are being checked.
*   **4**: The bucket is checked.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-oss-bucket-scan-info --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --bucket-name iboxpublic0000 --status 1 --has-risk 1 --fuzz-bucket-name test --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListOssBucketScanInfo --region cn-hangzhou --Status 1 --BucketName iboxpublic0000 --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --FuzzBucketName test --Lang zh --HasRisk 1
